team.title: Team (AI Agents)
team.subtitle: The AI agents running behind the scenes
team.architectureBody: Agents are data-driven — all behavior is defined by the prompt template stored in the database. The executor is a single generic function: it loads the task + creator, fetches relevant knowledge by creator status, applies config rules, renders the prompt template, calls the configured model, and parses the structured JSON output. Each agent can independently use Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini — configure via the dropdowns above. Adding a new agent requires only inserting a new row — no code changes.

parserFailed.body: Be more specific so I can identify the action, fields, and timeframe.
suggestions: [Create] Include category + date + amount + buyer, e.g. "Add a travel expense: taxi May 10 ¥320, buyer pollux"

[Query] State the category, time range, and metric, e.g. "How much of Q3 salary went to MC?"

articles.title: 3D Avatar Technology Team to Create Dedicated MC Characters for EchoAmp
articles.lead: EchoAmp will work with an experienced 3D avatar technology team from China’s live-streaming industry to develop dedicated character solutions for its MC roles.
body: The collaboration will integrate character design, real-time motion, voice performance, and live interaction, enabling MCs to appear consistently through distinctive virtual identities. The project will also explore new formats that combine live performers, virtual characters, and real-time streaming.

articles.title: EchoAmp Announces Its First Operations Partner, 吉光片羽株式会社
articles.lead: EchoAmp will enter into a close partnership with 吉光片羽株式会社, a media company with established experience in MCN operations and creator management.
body: The two companies will collaborate across talent management, content operations, on-site execution, and creator development. EchoAmp will lead the team’s overall brand and direction while combining its capabilities with its partner’s local operational experience in Japan.

articles.title: EchoAmp to Begin Its First Recruitment Round in Mid-September, Seeking Six Members
articles.lead: EchoAmp will begin its first team recruitment round in Osaka in mid-September 2026, with six female creators planned for the initial lineup.
body: Recruitment will focus on singing, dance, on-camera presence, and a strong commitment to live performance. Selected members will take part in training, choreography, and live-streaming practice while helping shape the style and culture of EchoAmp’s first performance team.

articles.title: EchoAmp Launches in Osaka with Plans to Build a Female Singing and Dancing Live Team
articles.lead: EchoAmp has officially launched its Creator Network project in Osaka.
body: Centered on singing, dance, and live performance, the project will discover female creators with strong potential and bring them together as a dedicated live-streaming team. Through training, content production, and continuous live shows, EchoAmp aims to build a distinctive team style, culture, and fan community around live streaming as a stage of its own.

articles.title: EchoAmp Announces New Dual-Captain Singing and Dance Group
articles.lead: We announced MOONDOLLZ, a dual-captain singing and dance group.
body: MOON is the dreamlike, nocturnal and mysterious; DOLLZ is the sense of a troupe where every member carries her own style; the closing Z is the temperature of Y2K and streetwear. The name stacks all three.
Sub-units are run with distinct character settings while debuting together as one group. The captains are Ayatsuki (MOON SIDE) and Yukiha (DOLLZ SIDE).
Members will be revealed progressively in October and December.

items.title: Live-streaming training
items.short: From zero: voice, camera work, talk design and metrics — a dedicated manager runs alongside you.
items.body: Built for people with no experience: voice, camera work, talk design, comment handling and metrics, taught in stages. A dedicated manager works with you daily, down to planning your stream slots.

items.title: AIGC idol drama
items.short: Short-form idol drama planned and produced with generative AI, building a world outside the stream.
items.body: Planning, writing and production of short idol dramas using generative AI. It builds a world beyond the stream and banks each member's character setting as footage.

items.title: Original music
items.short: Group and solo songs written to order, supplied to both streams and stages.
items.body: Group and solo songs written to order and supplied to streams, stages and film. The annual release and event calendar is built around the music.

items.title: Suit live technology
items.short: Fabrication, motion, voice and real-time staging in house — a field with few precedents in Japan.
items.body: Costumed-suit (kigurumi) streaming still has few precedents in Japan, and we keep that know-how in house: fabrication, motion, voice and real-time staging run as one, so a character IP can grow continuously without depending on the performer's face. One of EchoAmp's own differentiators.

subItems.title: Fabrication and suit design
subItems.body: Designed for how it reads on stream — silhouette, range of motion, field of view — plus airflow and weight balance for long sessions.

subItems.title: Motion linkage
subItems.body: Expression, glow and effect control that follow the performer, composited live on the streaming side.

subItems.title: Running it as IP
subItems.body: The character is an asset independent of any performer, extensible to AIGC film, music and merchandise.
